title: Words and Definitions
ringkas: Memahami kata lewat definisi sederhana dalam bahasa Inggris
goals: memahami kata lewat **definisi sederhana** dalam bahasa Inggris
menebak kata dari **petunjuk dalam bahasa Inggris**
mulai **berpikir dalam bahasa Inggris**, bukan lewat terjemahan

lesson.text: Kamus bahasa Inggris menjelaskan kata dengan kata-kata sederhana. Membaca definisi seperti ini melatihmu **berpikir dalam bahasa Inggris** dan membantu bila terjemahan tidak tersedia. Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya, lalu jawab pertanyaan *Which word means ...?*

lesson.title: 1. Pola definisi sederhana
table: [[A teacher is a person who teaches students.]]
[[To borrow means to take something and give it back later.]]
[[A library is a place where you can read and borrow books.]]

lesson.title: Cari kata kunci dalam definisi
lesson.text: Dalam definisi, kata benda umum (person, place, thing) dan kata kerja kunci memberi petunjuk. *A place where you sleep at night* → bedroom.

items: Definisi: a ... is a person/place/thing that ...

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: a person who helps sick people
a person who drives a car or bus
practice.exp: Definisi: teacher = a person who teaches students; doctor = a person who helps sick people; farmer = a person who grows food; driver = a person who drives a car or bus.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: a place where you can read and borrow books
a room where you cook food
a place where sick people get help
a place where people keep money
practice.exp: Definisi: library = a place where you can read and borrow books; kitchen = a room where you cook food; hospital = a place where sick people get help; bank = a place where people keep money.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
practice.exp: Definisi: hungry = wanting to eat; tired = needing to sleep or rest; angry = feeling very upset with someone; happy = feeling good and glad.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: to take something and give it back later
to give something to someone for a short time
to get something by paying money
to give something to someone for money
practice.exp: Definisi: borrow = to take something and give it back later; lend = to give something to someone for a short time; buy = to get something by paying money; sell = to give something to someone for money.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
practice.exp: Definisi: early = before the usual time; late = after the usual time; always = every time; never = not at any time.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: something you carry to stay dry in the rain
a drawing that shows where places are
something you use to open a door
a small case for money and cards
practice.exp: Definisi: umbrella = something you carry to stay dry in the rain; map = a drawing that shows where places are; key = something you use to open a door; wallet = a small case for money and cards.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: the first meal of the day
the meal in the middle of the day
the main meal in the evening
a small amount of food between meals
practice.exp: Definisi: breakfast = the first meal of the day; lunch = the meal in the middle of the day; dinner = the main meal in the evening; snack = a small amount of food between meals.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
practice.exp: Definisi: cheap = not costing much money; expensive = costing a lot of money; free = costing no money; rich = having a lot of money.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: with nothing or no one inside
practice.exp: Definisi: quiet = making very little noise; noisy = making a lot of noise; crowded = full of people; empty = with nothing or no one inside.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
practice.exp: Definisi: ancient = very old, from long ago; modern = new and up to date; popular = liked by many people; famous = known by many people.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: a document you need to travel to another country
a piece of paper that lets you travel or enter a place
the bags you take on a trip
something you buy to remember a place
practice.exp: Definisi: passport = a document you need to travel to another country; ticket = a piece of paper that lets you travel or enter a place; luggage = the bags you take on a trip; souvenir = something you buy to remember a place.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: to make sounds because something is funny
to have tears because you are sad
practice.exp: Definisi: whisper = to speak very quietly; shout = to speak very loudly; laugh = to make sounds because something is funny; cry = to have tears because you are sad.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
practice.exp: Definisi: improve = to become better; decrease = to become smaller in amount; increase = to become bigger in amount; avoid = to stay away from something.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: happy to give things to others
nervous with people you do not know
practice.exp: Definisi: honest = always telling the truth; polite = having good manners; generous = happy to give things to others; shy = nervous with people you do not know.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: a plan that shows when things will happen
the last time you can finish something
an event where people talk about work
a list of things to talk about in a meeting
practice.exp: Definisi: schedule = a plan that shows when things will happen; deadline = the last time you can finish something; meeting = an event where people talk about work; agenda = a list of things to talk about in a meeting.

practice.q: Pasangkan kata dengan definisinya.
pairs: dirty or harmful things in air, water, or land
practice.exp: Definisi: environment = the natural world around us; pollution = dirty or harmful things in air, water, or land; recycle = to use materials again; waste = things we throw away.
